projectName: AutoFair — Automotive Repair Quote & Anti-Upsell Auditor
elevatorPitch: An open, unbiased repair quote auditor that protects drivers from inflated mechanic labor hours, 300% parts markups, and predatory dealer chemical flushes.

gallery.caption: AutoFair Quote Audit Dashboard: Total quoted bill decomposed into standard book labor hours and wholesale parts fair market benchmarks.
One-click presets loaded from authentic Reddit r/MechanicAdvice quote controversies, showing real dealer markups and fair shop baselines.
Anti-Upsell Radar flagging predatory dealership profit-center flushes that are not mandated by manufacturer factory maintenance schedules.
One-click mechanic counter-negotiation scripts and DIY feasibility alternatives with tool lists and video tutorial links.
Unbiased comparison matrix demonstrating AutoFair's consumer advocacy advantages over ad-supported platforms like RepairPal and KBB.
